Can you describe the appearance of your rash on the scalp and forehead, and when did it first appear? 

Also, have you noticed any pain, itching, or fluid drainage from the affected areas?

speaker: Patient
text: 3-month-old boy. The parents report that the rash has been present for several weeks, noting that it sometimes appears red and scaly, especially during cold weather. The patient was born at 36 weeks' gestation and has been generally healthy since. The patient's father has a history of psoriasis.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Infantile Seborrheic Dermatitis (cradle cap) with family history of psoriasis. The seasonal flare and family history suggest a genetic predisposition, but the presentation is classic for seborrheic dermatitis in an infant. I will monitor for potential progression to psoriasis if lesions become well-demarcated and silvery-scaled.
